'''Red Squadron''' was a [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]]. It was part of the [[Coruscant Third Fleet]] and participated in the [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Ralltiir]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].
